Container.Name: netzwart
Container.Overview:
See every device on your home network. Netzwart finds every device, gives it a readable name and icon, shows who is online and tells you when an unknown device appears or the internet goes down. The overview draws your network as a ring around the router.
It also checks your network for the usual weak spots: open Telnet or RDP, devices without security updates, a second DHCP server, ARP spoofing of the router address and known exploited vulnerabilities in Apple devices, each with plain advice on what to do.
Notifications via ntfy, Gotify, Pushover, Telegram, Discord, Slack, webhook and e-mail. Home Assistant via MQTT. Optional FRITZ!Box integration with Wi-Fi diagnosis. No cloud, no subscription, no telemetry.
Needs the host network for layer-2 discovery. The container is read-only and drops every Linux capability right after start-up. Open the web UI within 30 minutes of the first start to create your account (there is no default password).
Container.Changes: [b]0.3.2[/b] Wi-Fi map with heatmap from phone measurements, tripwire decoy ports, DNS manipulation check, device history and inventory.
Container.Requires: Host network (layer-2 discovery). Port 8840 must be free on the server; change "Web UI port" otherwise.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface (host network, so this is the port on your server).

Config.Name: Run as user (PUID)
Config.Description: Netzwart switches to this user after start-up. 99 = nobody (Unraid default for appdata).

Config.Name: Run as group (PGID)
Config.Description: Group for the data folder. 100 = users.

Config.Name: Network interfaces
Config.Description: Interfaces to scan, e.g. br0 or eth0,br0.1. Empty = the interface with the default route.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Extra host names Netzwart answers to, e.g. netzwart.example.com behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: IPs or networks of your reverse proxy, so Netzwart sees the real client IP.
